assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: individual Unity 2D game sprite, a SINGLE isolated item.
Use attached character_base.png as STYLE REFERENCE ONLY: match its thick smooth black outlines, simplified rounded shapes, flat saturated colors, minimal clean cel shading, restrained broad highlight. Do not reproduce the dog, body parts or layout. NOT realistic, NOT painterly, NOT detailed textures or 3D.
Genuinely transparent alpha background. One object centered in the canvas, clean transparent padding on every side. Entire object fully visible. No scene, ground shadow, text, border, background rectangle, UI, multiple objects, sparkles, VFX, trails, particles, motion blur, arcs, fire, glow, or action lines. Do not include effects within the sprite. Crisp black outside contour readable at mobile icon size.
Subject: ONE long ivory cartoon bone used as a primitive bone club. Fully HORIZONTAL major axis left-to-right, nearly straight shaft, thick rounded knobby double lobes at both ends, larger rounded club head at RIGHT and smaller double knob at LEFT. Pale warm ivory fill, simple cream shadow stripe, tiny broad pale highlight. Clearly a BONE, not a rock, not wooden club, no meat, no handle wrapping. Use wide landscape composition, bone fills about 80% of canvas width.
assets.axis: Horizontal +X; larger bone club head right
assets.visualReview: One distinct item; complete silhouette and transparent padding; no baked VFX/trails/particles.
